shell_commands:
git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(tools): validate tool input against inputSchema in execute

failure instead of throwing, allowing the model to correct malformed
calls within the tool-round budget. Errors name field paths and
constraint types without leaking values.
EOF
)"
